hero.intro: FenderTec supplies pneumatic Yokohama-type fenders from stock. Our quality management system is certified to ISO 9001.
hero.success_message: Thank you. Your request has been sent.
hero.image_alt: Pneumatic Yokohama-type fenders with tire nets

iso.heading: Pneumatic fenders manufactured to ISO 17357
iso.benefit_1: High energy absorption with low reaction forces
iso.benefit_2: Protective sleeves and rubber discs in the tire net shield the chains along their full length
iso.benefit_3: Galvanized chains, shackles and swivel joints as standard
iso.image_alt: Pneumatic Yokohama fender undergoing a compression test
iso.details_html:
The fender body is made of several layers of rubber reinforced with synthetic cords. On net-type fenders, the chain and tire net protects the rubber body from abrasion. The fender is initially inflated to 50 kPa (0.5 bar) as standard. An 80 kPa version is available on request.

See the product brochure for technical data. Test reports are available on request.

examples.heading: Examples of Yokohama-type fenders supplied by FenderTec
examples.case_1_copy_html:
A customer needed pneumatic fenders in a size outside our standard range. We supplied fenders with a chain and tire net in the dimensions the project called for.

If you need a custom size, tell us the diameter, length and where the fender will be used. We also supply custom-sized sling fenders and foam-filled PU fenders.
examples.case_2_heading: Two large pneumatic fenders supplied from stock
examples.case_2_copy_html:
A customer needed two large Yokohama-type fenders with chain and tire nets at short notice. We stock larger sizes as well, so both fenders were available in the requested size straight away.

We loaded the two fenders onto one low-loader and secured them for delivery.
examples.case_3_copy_html:
A ship was due to sail and the customer needed pneumatic fenders before departure. We had the required size in stock, arranged transport and delivered the fenders the same day.

For urgent orders, tell us where the fenders need to go and when the ship is due to sail. We’ll check stock and transport availability against your deadline.

examples.case_2_image_alt: Two large pneumatic fenders with tire nets secured on a low-loader

Pneumatic fenders with reinforcing rubber ribs are available on request.

page.definition_html:
What are Yokohama fenders?

Yokohama fenders are floating, air-filled rubber fenders. As a vessel comes alongside and presses against the fender, the air inside the reinforced rubber body compresses. This absorbs berthing energy and helps protect the hull and berth.

The name comes from the Yokohama Rubber Company, which developed this design. FenderTec supplies its own pneumatic fenders of this type.
page.applications_html:
Where are pneumatic fenders used?

Pneumatic fenders protect vessels at berths and during ship-to-ship operations such as bunkering and cargo transfers. They’re also used in offshore and dredging work. Floating fenders follow changes in water level and can be moved between berths as needed.
page.selection_html:
Which type of fender do you need?

A chain and tire net gives the rubber body extra protection from abrasion. A sling fender has end fittings for lifting and securing it. Foam-filled PU fenders are an alternative if you need a floating fender that works without internal air pressure.
